expectation: Membrane ring on small lymphocytes (most T cells, NK cells). Common in immune-infiltrated tumour: scattered single cells in the stroma, denser in lymphoid aggregates and immune-rich areas, mostly absent from tumour nests.
observed: A: discrete small yellow cells in most images, with density varying from image to image (dense in immune-rich ones, sparse in others). One image shows faint haze. B, C: a few separate small cells with rings, in stroma. D: a cluster of membrane-stained lymphocytes.
why: Discrete lymphocyte-sized cells with membrane staining, whose density changes between immune-rich and immune-poor images, is the expected T/NK pattern.
notes: CD7 marks discrete small cells, densest in the immune-rich images and sparse elsewhere; panel D shows a membrane-stained lymphocyte cluster. There is mild haze in one image, but the cellular pattern is clear.
